events.pageview: One view per initial load or pathname navigation
events.ReelClip.Web.downloadClicked: Outbound App Store intent; placement and website page group
events.ReelClip.Web.tutorialReachedEnd: First reached-end event per mounted tutorial; not proof every second was watched

test_mode: Non-production hosts and td_test=true are marked as test events. Exclude these from acquisition analysis.
privacy: No client cookies or persistent IDs. Only pathname, cleaned referrer, language, approved UTM tags and categorical event parameters are sent. No form values or arbitrary query parameters.
identity_limit: Web visitor identifiers reset daily and cannot link website visits to native app installations.
read_status: Dashboard verified via existing signed-in account. No new query API credentials were created. Daily numeric website reporting requires an actual dashboard read/export or a separately authorized API connection; missing metrics are unknown.
apple: Keep the verified website_main / website_guides Apple campaign links and existing App Store analytics collector.
verification: Local production-build browser pageview and real download click appeared in the website Test Mode explorer, with path, placement, campaign and web.v3 ingest parameters.
